cues.zh: 人体免疫系统是我们所知最复杂的生物系统，仅次于人脑，
cues.en: The human immune system is the most complex biological system we know, after the human brain,

cues.zh: 然而我们大多数人从未了解它是如何运作的。
cues.en: and yet most of us never learn how it works.

cues.zh: 甚至不知道它是什么。
cues.en: Or, what it is.

cues.zh: 你的免疫系统由数百个微小器官和两个大型器官组成。
cues.en: Your immune system consists of hundreds of tiny—and two large—organs.

cues.zh: 它有一套遍布全身的运输网络。
cues.en: It has its own transport network spread throughout your body.

cues.zh: 每天，它制造数千亿个新鲜细胞，像军队一样组织起来。
cues.en: Every day, it makes hundreds of billions of fresh cells organized like an army.

cues.zh: 有士兵、上尉、情报官、重型武器，还有疯狂的自杀式炸弹手。
cues.en: With soldiers, captains, intelligence officers, heavy weapons, and crazy suicide bombers.

cues.zh: 它不是某种抽象实体。
cues.en: It's not some sort of abstract entity.

cues.zh: 你的免疫系统就是你。
cues.en: Your immune system is you.

cues.zh: 是你的生物机制在保护你，免受数十亿想要吞噬你的微生物侵害，
cues.en: Your biology protecting you from the billions of microorganisms that want to consume you,

cues.zh: 也保护你免受自身变异细胞变成癌症的威胁。
cues.en: and from your own perverted cells that turn into cancer.

cues.zh: 它太复杂了，一个视频根本讲不完，
cues.en: It's so manifold that it's impossible to cover in one video,

cues.zh: 所以我们会做一个系列，从不同角度来探讨它。
cues.en: so we'll make a series looking at different aspects of it.

cues.zh: 今天：当你的身体被入侵时会发生什么
cues.en: Today: What happens when your body is invaded

cues.zh: 你的第一道防线投入了一场生死搏斗。
cues.en: and your first lines of defenses are engaged in a fight for life and death.

cues.zh: 本来是个平常的日子，
cues.en: It's been a normal day,

cues.zh: 突然世界爆炸了，一颗小行星撕裂了天空。
cues.en: when suddenly the world explodes and an asteroid rips the sky open.

cues.zh: 无数外星生命体入侵，
cues.en: Countless alien life forms invade,

cues.zh: 准备摧毁城市和基础设施，还要吃掉平民……
cues.en: ready to destroy cities and infrastructure, and eat civilians...

cues.zh: 或者，这就是你的细胞所经历的。
cues.en: Or, this is what your cells experience.

cues.zh: 你看着刚在公园里被脏树枝划破、正在流血的大拇指。
cues.en: You look at your bleeding thumb that you just cut on a dirty twig in the park.

cues.zh: 真烦人！
cues.en: How annoying!

cues.zh: 但在伤口内部，一场可怕的大灾难已经发生。
cues.en: But inside the wound, a horrible catastrophe has happened.

cues.zh: 到处都是死细胞、血液和污垢。
cues.en: There are dead cells, and blood and dirt everywhere.

cues.zh: 更糟的是，无数细菌入侵了你无助细胞之间的温暖洞穴，
cues.en: Even worse, countless bacteria invade the warm caverns between your helpless cells

cues.zh: 探索它们的新家，偷走你的资源，还到处拉屎。
cues.en: to explore their new home, steal your resources, and poop everywhere.

cues.zh: 立刻，你防御的第一阶段启动了。
cues.en: Immediately, the first stage of your defense kicks in.

cues.zh: 受冲击后存活、受伤或垂死的细胞会惊恐尖叫，
cues.en: The cells that survive the impact, or are hurt or dying, scream in panic

cues.zh: 释放出大量化学警报信号，唤醒你的免疫系统。
cues.en: releasing an onslaught of chemical alarm signals that awaken your immune system.

cues.zh: 最先赶到的是巨噬细胞。
cues.en: The first cells to show up are macrophages.

cues.zh: 如果把普通细胞放大到人的体型，巨噬细胞就有黑犀牛那么大。
cues.en: If an average cell were the size of a human, a macrophage would be the size of a black rhino.

cues.zh: 它原则上很沉稳，但你最好别惹它。
cues.en: A stoic cell in principle but you wouldn't want to annoy it.

cues.zh: 细菌偏偏就要惹它们。
cues.en: Bacteria -do- annoy them.

cues.zh: 几秒钟内，这些大细胞就发动攻击，开始毫不留情地杀死它们。
cues.en: Within seconds, the large cells attack and begin killing them without mercy.

cues.zh: 它们伸出像章鱼触手一样的部分，
cues.en: They stretch out parts like the arms of an octopus,

cues.zh: 抓住细菌，整个吞下，活活消化掉。
cues.en: and grab the bacteria to swallow them whole and digest them alive.

cues.zh: 一个巨噬细胞在筋疲力尽前能吃掉100个细菌。
cues.en: A macrophage can eat 100 bacteria before it's exhausted.

cues.zh: 但敌人太多了，于是巨噬细胞呼叫增援。
cues.en: But there are too many enemies, so the macrophages call for reinforcements.

cues.zh: 你血液中数十万计的中性粒细胞接收到信号，奔赴战场。
cues.en: In your blood, hundreds of thousands of neutrophils pick up their signals and move to the battlefield.

cues.zh: 中性粒细胞是凶猛的敢死队，活着就是为了杀戮。
cues.en: Neutrophils are intense suicide warriors that only live to kill.

cues.zh: 它们对杀戮如此狂热，以至于出生几天后就自我了断，
cues.en: They're so enthusiastic about killing that they kill themselves a few days after birth,

cues.zh: 这样就没时间不小心从内部摧毁你的身体。
cues.en: so they don't have time to accidentally destroy your body from the inside.

cues.zh: 中性粒细胞一到场，就开始朝细菌喷洒致命化学物质，或者直接把它们吞掉。
cues.en: As soon as neutrophils arrive, they begin vomiting deadly chemicals at bacteria, or devour them.

cues.zh: 它们攻击起来毫不顾及，对你自己的细胞也造成了实实在在的伤害。
cues.en: They are so careless in their attacks that they are causing real damage to your own cells.

cues.zh: 但附带损伤现在不是它们关心的事，
cues.en: But collateral damage is not their concern now,

cues.zh: 以后也不是。
cues.en: or ever.

cues.zh: 有些中性粒细胞甚至按下自毁按钮爆炸，
cues.en: Some neutrophils go so far to push their suicide button and explode,

cues.zh: 用自己的DNA织成一张宽大而有毒的网，网上布满致命化学物质，将细菌困住并杀死。
cues.en: casting a wide and toxic net made from their own DNA filled with deadly chemicals that trap and kill bacteria.

cues.zh: 有时，它们之后还能继续战斗，尽管它们已经算是死了。
cues.en: Sometimes, they can continue fighting after that, even though they're sort of dead already.

cues.zh: 它们杀起来就是这么带劲！
cues.en: This is how much fun they have killing!

cues.zh: 当战斗激烈进行时，你的血管就像向山谷开闸的水坝一样，让液体涌入战场。
cues.en: While the battle rages, your blood vessels let fluid stream into the battlefield like a dam opening up towards a valley.

cues.zh: 你会把这感知为炎症。
cues.en: You notice this as inflammation.

cues.zh: 你的拇指有点肿起来，变得又红又热。
cues.en: Your thumb swells up a little and gets red and warm.

cues.zh: 这些液体把一个无声杀手带进了战区——数以百万计的补体蛋白。
cues.en: The fluid brings a silent killer into the battle zone, millions of complement proteins.

cues.zh: 这是一种自动化的液体武器，通过给细菌撕开孔洞来把它们击晕并杀死。
cues.en: A sort of automated liquid weapon that stuns and kills bacteria by ripping holes into them.

cues.zh: 我们做了一整期视频详细讲解它们。
cues.en: We made a whole video explaining them in detail.

cues.zh: 现在我们来到了一个十字路口。
cues.en: We are reaching a crossroad now.

cues.zh: 如果一切顺利，你的第一道防线会迅速杀死入侵者。
cues.en: If things go well, your first line of defense kills the invaders quickly.

cues.zh: 但有时候，敌人太强，最终会压垮你的防御，
cues.en: But sometimes, the enemies are too strong and would overwhelm your defenses eventually,

cues.zh: 这意味着你——人类——必死无疑。
cues.en: which means certain death for you, the human.

cues.zh: 这是树突状细胞的时代，它是你免疫系统的情报官。
cues.en: This is the hour of the dendritic cell, your immune system's intelligence officer.

cues.zh: 当你的士兵在战场上厮杀时，
cues.en: While your soldiers were bashing in heads,

cues.zh: 它却在收集样本，把细菌撕成碎片并裹在自己身上。
cues.en: it was collecting samples by ripping bacteria into tiny parts and covering itself in it.

cues.zh: 就像一个士兵用死去敌人的内脏装饰自己。
cues.en: Like a soldier decorating itself in the guts of a dead enemy.

cues.zh: 这个细胞离开战场，进入你免疫系统的超级高速公路，
cues.en: The cell leaves the battlefield and enters the superhighway of your immune system

cues.zh: 这条路连接着你所有的组织和免疫总部。
cues.en: that connects all your tissues with your immune headquarters.

cues.zh: 也就是你的淋巴结。
cues.en: Your lymph nodes.

cues.zh: 从战场归来的树突状细胞正在寻找辅助T细胞，
cues.en: The dendritic cell coming from the battlefield is looking for a helper T cell,

cues.zh: 辅助T细胞算是你免疫大军中的全能指挥官。
cues.en: which is a sort of all-purpose commander cell within your immune army.

cues.zh: 但不是随便哪个辅助T细胞。
cues.en: But not any helper T cell.

cues.zh: 而是恰好拥有对付感染你伤口的细菌的合适武器的那个。
cues.en: One that happens to have just the right weapon for the bacteria that infected your wound.

cues.zh: 于是它四处游走，身上仍裹着细菌碎片，与遇到的每一个辅助T细胞摩擦接触。
cues.en: So it goes around and rubs itself, still covered in bacteria parts, against every helper T cell it meets.

cues.zh: 大多数T细胞都有点嫌弃，不感兴趣。
cues.en: Most T cells are a bit disgusted and not interested.

cues.zh: 但几小时后，情况突然有了转机。
cues.en: But after a few hours, something clicks.

cues.zh: 一个辅助T细胞识别出了细菌的片段。
cues.en: A helper T cell recognizes the bacteria parts.

cues.zh: 这个细胞正是当下需要的武器。
cues.en: This cell is the weapon that's needed right now.

cues.zh: 树突状细胞大喜过望，激活了辅助T细胞。
cues.en: The dendritic cell is overjoyed and activates the helper T cell.

cues.zh: 等等。
cues.en: Okay, wait.

cues.zh: 你的免疫系统怎么会有专门针对感染你的那种细菌的武器细胞呢？
cues.en: How come your immune system has a cell that has a weapon against the specific bacteria that infected you?

cues.zh: 其实，你的免疫系统拥有对付宇宙中每一种可能疾病的完美武器。
cues.en: Well, your immune system has a perfect weapon against every possible disease in the universe.

cues.zh: 无论是黑死病、冠状病毒，还是一百年后火星上才出现的感染。
cues.en: Against the Black Death, the Coronavirus, or an infection that will emerge in 100 years on Mars.

cues.zh: 这个我们下个视频再细聊，因为实在太复杂了。
cues.en: We'll talk about this a bit more in the next video because it's very complex.

cues.zh: 所以现在你只需要知道，你有数十亿个独特的辅助T细胞，
cues.en: So, for now, just know that you have billions of unique helper T cells

cues.zh: 每一个都带着对付各种可能敌人的武器。
cues.en: that each have weapons against every possible enemy.

cues.zh: 正确的 T 细胞被激活后，你的第二道防线苏醒了
cues.en: After the right T cell is activated, your second line of defense awakes

cues.zh: 然后像个上学日赖床的青少年一样爬起来……
cues.en: and rises like a teenager that needs to get up on a school day...

cues.zh: 非常慢。
cues.en: Very slowly.

cues.zh: 你的重型武器极其有效，但它们并不快。
cues.en: Your heavy weapons are incredibly effective but they're not fast.

cues.zh: 被激活的辅助 T 细胞开始一遍又一遍地克隆自己。
cues.en: The activated helper T cell begins to clone itself over and over again.

cues.zh: 一个变两个，两个变四个，直到有成千上万个。
cues.en: One becomes two, two become four, until there are thousands of them.

cues.zh: 现在，它们分成两组。
cues.en: Now, they split into two groups.

cues.zh: 第一组迅速前去支援你的士兵。
cues.en: The first group quickly moves to help out your soldiers.

cues.zh: 战场上，局势正在失控。
cues.en: At the battlefield, things are getting out of hand.

cues.zh: 一个疲惫的巨噬细胞准备放弃了。
cues.en: A tired macrophage is ready to give up.

cues.zh: 战斗了几天后，它只想睡觉，就像它的许多伙伴已经做的那样。
cues.en: After fighting for days, it just wants to go to sleep like many of its buddies have done already.

cues.zh: 但这时辅助 T 细胞赶到了。
cues.en: But now the helper T cells arrive.

cues.zh: 其中一个来到疲惫的巨噬细胞身边，用特殊的化学信号悄悄说了些什么。
cues.en: One of them comes to the tired macrophage and whispers something using special chemical signals.

cues.zh: 一瞬间，士气低落的士兵又感觉焕然一新。
cues.en: In a heartbeat, the demoralized soldier feels fresh again.

cues.zh: 但还有别的东西。
cues.en: But there's something else.

cues.zh: 一股炽热的白色怒火。
cues.en: A hot white anger.

cues.zh: 巨噬细胞知道自己该做什么……
cues.en: The macrophage knows what it needs to do...

cues.zh: 杀。
cues.en: Kill.

cues.zh: 它精神大振，再次冲向敌人。
cues.en: Invigorated, it throws itself against the enemies once again.

cues.zh: 整个战场上，这种情况开始发生。
cues.en: All over the battlefield, this begins to happen.

cues.zh: 与此同时，第二组辅助T细胞正在着手激活另一道防线：
cues.en: Meanwhile, the second group of helper T cells was working on activating another line of defense:

cues.zh: B细胞，你的抗体工厂。
cues.en: B cells, your antibody factories.

cues.zh: 抗体是蛋白质超级武器，看起来像小螃蟹，用两只钳子抓住敌人。
cues.en: Antibodies are protein super weapons that look like tiny crabs with two pincers to grab enemies.

cues.zh: 和辅助T细胞一样，你体内也有B细胞，
cues.en: Just like the helper T cells, there are B cells in your body

cues.zh: 能够为每一种可能的敌人制造出恰好合适的抗体。
cues.en: that are able to make just the right antibodies for every possible enemy.

cues.zh: 而辅助T细胞要找的正是这些B细胞。
cues.en: And the helper T cell is looking for exactly these B cells.

cues.zh: 一两天后，合适的B细胞被找到了，并开始克隆自己。
cues.en: After a day or two, the right B cell is found, and begins to clone itself.

cues.zh: 一旦复制出足够多的克隆体，
cues.en: As soon as enough clones have been made,

cues.zh: 每个 B 细胞开始每秒释放多达 2,000 个抗体！
cues.en: each B cell begins pumping out up to 2,000 antibodies per second!

cues.zh: 在你受伤、细菌入侵后大约一周，
cues.en: About a week after you injured yourself and bacteria invaded,

cues.zh: 你的第二道防线终于全力赶到。
cues.en: your second line of defense finally arrives in full force.

cues.zh: 这支微小的军队开始铺满战场，夹击并麻痹走投无路的细菌。
cues.en: The tiny army begins to saturate the battlefield, pinching and stunning desperate bacteria.

cues.zh: 抗体把它们黏在一起，让它们无法移动或战斗，
cues.en: The antibodies clump them together and make them unable to move or fight,

cues.zh: 而你的士兵则屠杀这些毫无防御的受害者。
cues.en: while your soldiers massacre the defenseless victims.

cues.zh: 局势正在迅速扭转。
cues.en: The tide is turning fast.

cues.zh: 当最后的敌人被清理干净，你的士兵意识到自己已不再被需要，
cues.en: As the last enemies are cleaned up, your soldiers realize they are no longer needed,

cues.zh: 便开始自我了断以节省资源。
cues.en: and begin to kill themselves to save resources.

cues.zh: 但并非全部如此。
cues.en: But not all of them.

cues.zh: 少数辅助 T 细胞留下来，转变为记忆细胞。
cues.en: A few helper T cells remain and turn into memory cells.

cues.zh: 它们将守卫这片组织多年，
cues.en: They will guard the tissue for years,

cues.zh: 确保同样的细菌再也不会在这里立足。
cues.en: making sure the same bacteria will never again gain a foothold here.

cues.zh: 同样，一些 B 细胞会继续存活
cues.en: Similarly, a few B cells will stay alive

cues.zh: 并持续产生少量抗体，
cues.en: and keep producing a low amount of antibodies,

cues.zh: 让你对这种细菌免疫，
cues.en: making you immune against this bacteria,

cues.zh: 也许终生免疫。
cues.en: maybe for the rest of your life.

cues.zh: 有一天你醒来，发现伤口已经愈合
cues.en: One day you wake up and notice that the wound has grown over

cues.zh: 只留下一道淡淡的红色印记。
cues.en: and left nothing but a faint red mark.

cues.zh: 你完全不知道你的细胞经历了怎样的波澜。
cues.en: You were completely unaware of the drama your cells had to deal with.

cues.zh: 对你来说，这整件事只是小小的烦恼。
cues.en: For you, the whole ordeal was a slight annoyance.

cues.zh: 而对数百万个细胞来说，这是一场生死搏斗。
cues.en: While for millions of cells, it was a desperate fight for life and death.

cues.zh: 但这只是每天在你体内上演的史诗故事的开始，
cues.en: But this is just the beginning of the epic story that unfolds inside you every day,

cues.zh: 完整讲述于
cues.en: and is told in full in

cues.zh: 《免疫：深入维系你生命的神秘系统之旅》，
cues.en: "Immune: A Journey into the Mysterious System That Keeps You Alive",

cues.zh: 作者是 Philipp Dettmer，Kurzgesagt 的创始人兼首席撰稿人。
cues.en: written by Philipp Dettmer, the founder and head writer of Kurzgesagt.

cues.zh: 这本书配有精美插图，深入探讨免疫系统，
cues.en: The book is a beautifully illustrated deep dive into the immune system,

cues.zh: 那是你了解得远远不够的最重要的事物，
cues.en: the most important thing you don't know enough about,

cues.zh: 它将永远改变你对自身身体的看法。
cues.en: that will forever change how you think about your body.

cues.zh: 力求写得尽可能简单有趣，
cues.en: Written to be as simple and fun as possible,

cues.zh: 这个项目我倾注热情做了将近十年
cues.en: it's been an ongoing passion project for almost a decade

cues.zh: 因为免疫系统几乎是最神奇、最迷人的话题了。
cues.en: because the immune system is just about the most amazing and fascinating topic there is.

cues.zh: 所以，来一趟旅程，认识一下你自己的身体吧。
cues.en: So, go on a journey and get to know your own body.

cues.zh: 从神秘器官、谋杀大学，到宇宙中最大的图书馆。
cues.en: From mystery organs, murder universities, to the largest library in the universe.

cues.zh: 探索你的免疫系统有多么庞大，以及它究竟是如何运作的。
cues.en: Explore how incredibly vast your immune system is and how it actually works.

cues.zh: 它如何对抗从癌症到HIV，或者只是流感的敌人。
cues.en: How it fights enemies from cancer to HIV, or just the flu.

cues.zh: 了解如何增强它，以及这到底是不是个好主意。
cues.en: Learn how you can boost it and if that's actually a good idea.

cues.zh: 这本书将在六周后出版
cues.en: The book will be out in six weeks

cues.zh: 如果你能预购，对我和Philipp来说意义非凡。
cues.en: and it would mean the world to us and Philipp if you could pre-order it.

cues.zh: 预购在图书界超级重要，
cues.en: Pre-ordering is super important in the world of books,

cues.zh: 和游戏不同，我们可以保证它确实已经完成了
cues.en: and in contrast to games, we can guarantee that it's actually finished

cues.zh: 而且不会有首日补丁。
